Name: The Holiest Fluffiness
Punchline: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog:
In /hdebug, hovering a column title in the Plugins tab now shows the total for that column across all your plugins: how many are loaded out of how many are installed, their combined share of the frame, total hooks and texture memory, the worst spike and how much texture memory has grown since the window opened.

There is also a new "Hide self" checkbox to leave Holiest Fluffiness out of the list, since its draw time includes the hdebug window itself.
